CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents is present (A absent).

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) and an explicit organization/access origin are both given for the same referent/time, and the report separates content lists from origin fields (supporting D).

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented items and an attribute (color) with coordinates.

D.rationale: The report separately provides content lists (red/blue coordinates) and separate origin/status fields for the same referent, distinguishing identification from provenance/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation fields describe how contents are organized/presented (history_estimate, command_estimate) for current and candidate entries.
